about: The umbrella's shared data: the section names, addresses and one-line descriptions, the hub's tagline, the guides list and the version line. tools/build_hub.py builds the hub and the guides index from it, and tools/build_web.py draws the map's umbrella bar from it. The Zero Trust guide's build and the Agentic SecOps landing and app carry the same bar, and tools/check_umbrella.py holds every page to this file. Counts are never typed here: build_hub.py reads them from content/stack.json, the guides list and the Agentic SecOps sources.
name: Lensatic

sections.name: Framework Maps
sections.hero: Framework Maps shows what each federal cyber framework is for, how the frameworks relate and who each one binds.
sections.line: What each framework is for, how they fit together and who each one binds, with zero trust and AI in view.

sections.name: Field Guides
sections.hero: Field Guides walks the eight-week Zero Trust route: a shared core, then a track for where you work, with one-page references.
sections.line: Guided study routes. The first is Zero Trust: eight weeks, a shared core, three tracks and one-page references.

sections.name: Playbook
sections.hero: Playbook holds Agentic SecOps, a tradecraft playbook for red, blue and purple teaming in the age of agentic AI.
sections.line: Agentic SecOps: a tradecraft playbook for red, blue and purple teaming in the age of agentic AI.

guides.name: Zero Trust
guides.line: Eight weeks from practitioner to lead. A shared core, then a track for where you work.
guides.shape: Weeks 1 to 4 are the shared core, for everyone: NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model. Weeks 5 to 8 are your track.
guides.references: A one-page quick reference for each track, and the whole study guide as a printable PDF.

notebook.name: Zero Trust in the Age of AI
notebook.line: A companion NotebookLM notebook built on the guide's sources, the 2025 to 2026 guidance on AI agents and recorded talks. Anyone with the link and a Google account can read it and ask it questions.
